Welcome to the Big Night at the museum!

📖 Lesson slides

Click the slide (or press → / Space) to show the next part. ← goes back. Press 🔊 to listen.

Mission 1 · Words and meanings: Drag and drop

Drag each word to its meaning. (On a tablet you can also tap a word, then tap a box.)

Mission 2 · Drag the words into the sentences

Drag each word to the right sentence. (On a tablet you can also tap a word, then tap a gap.)

Mission 3 · Listen and write the word

Press 🔊 and listen. Write the word you hear.

Mission 4 · Listen and choose

Press ▶ Listen. Choose the picture that matches what you hear.

Mission 5 · Read and answer

Read about Minh's Big Night. You can press 🔊 to listen too. Then choose the right answer.

Choose the right answer.

Mission 6 · Speaking: Answer the questions

1) Press 🔊 to hear the question. 2) Press 🎤 and answer in a full sentence. 3) Press ▶ to hear yourself. Stuck? Press 💡.
